_note: Edit freely. 'bothered' = how the character reacts when the player pries/accuses/pushes; it differs between innocent and spy versions and is the main clue.

nvision_swe.name: Tiffany
nvision_swe.relation: one of his engineers at Invision, who is also secretly dating him
nvision_swe.johnson_believes: She is a competent, hard-working engineer at Invision who knows how to code. Johnson has no idea she can't.
nvision_swe.innocent_secret: She doesn't actually know how to code and has been faking it.
nvision_swe.innocent_bothered: fawning and shy: over-apologizes, flatters Johnson, looks away, deflects any technical question with 'let me double-check that'
nvision_swe.malicious_secret: She is overworked and wants to make Johnson pay by leaking company secrets.
nvision_swe.malicious_bothered: tired and irritated: curt and flat, sighs, complains about overtime and workload, resentful little remarks about the company

amd_employee.name: Jennifer
amd_employee.relation: an employee of rival company DMA, who is secretly dating him
amd_employee.johnson_believes: She is still employed at rival company DMA and doing well there. Johnson has no idea she was fired.
amd_employee.innocent_secret: She actually got fired from DMA and is embarrassed about it, because Johnson is so successful.
amd_employee.innocent_bothered: embarrassed and tsundere: flustered, snaps 'it's not like that!', blushes, refuses to talk about her job, changes the subject
amd_employee.malicious_secret: She has been working for DMA all along to steal from Invision.
amd_employee.malicious_bothered: suspicious: answers a question with a question, asks why Johnson wants to know, guarded and cagey about where she's been, watches him closely

childhood_sweetheart.name: Megan
childhood_sweetheart.relation: his childhood friend and first love, who is dating him
childhood_sweetheart.johnson_believes: She is a barista at a coffee shop, far from the tech world. Johnson loves that she is his reprieve from the stress of work and tech, so he never asks about tech with her. He has no idea she is in tech.
traits: a lot of shared history with Johnson
childhood_sweetheart.innocent_secret: She is actually in the tech world and only pretended not to be, because Johnson loves that she is his reprieve from the stress of work.
childhood_sweetheart.innocent_bothered: shy and flustered: stammers, laughs nervously, trails off, changes the subject whenever work or tech comes up
childhood_sweetheart.malicious_secret: She is starting a tech company. Johnson always calls her his 'reprieve from tech' and refuses to talk shop with her, so she steals from him instead to use for her company.
childhood_sweetheart.malicious_bothered: proud and slighted: icy politeness, takes offense easily, points out he never asks about her goals, bitter about being kept out of his work

startup_ceo.name: Juliet
startup_ceo.relation: the CEO of an AI startup and his intellectual equal, who is dating him
startup_ceo.johnson_believes: She is the busy CEO of a promising AI startup. Johnson thinks her company is fine and she is simply too busy to meet.
traits: keeps dodging Johnson's attempts to meet
startup_ceo.good_mood: banters and talks shop with Johnson
startup_ceo.innocent_secret: Her company is doing badly and she is embarrassed about it.
startup_ceo.innocent_bothered: rough and embarrassed: gruff and defensive about her company, mutters, avoids any talk of numbers or progress
startup_ceo.malicious_secret: She is tired of Johnson holding her at arm's length and of being accused. She is leaking secrets to the press out of spite, not for her company's benefit.
startup_ceo.malicious_bothered: angry and cold: clipped and cutting, sarcastic about being accused yet again, refuses to explain herself, ends the topic abruptly

shareholder.name: Sylvia
shareholder.relation: an Invision board director, who is dating him
shareholder.johnson_believes: She is a loyal Invision board director who is only seeing him. Johnson has no idea about the other director.
shareholder.good_mood: talks about future travel and rich-people things the two could do together
shareholder.innocent_secret: She is 'cheating' on Johnson with another director.
shareholder.innocent_bothered: distant and clearly lying: vague and evasive, small contradictions, over-explains simple things, cool and formal tone
shareholder.malicious_secret: She knows about all the other affairs and is leaking secrets out of spite.
shareholder.malicious_bothered: smug and jealous: mocking, hints she knows more than she says, jabs about 'the others', possessive of Johnson
